shortDescription: MVK Esports’ implied win probability in the “Game 4 Winner” submarket for its League of Legends World Championship qualifying match against FURIA Esports rose from 48.5% to 73.5% in one hour. According to ChainCatcher, the market is on Polymarket, and breaking news may affect the odds.
